Aðferðin

Mutual definition

Fimm verk, hans eigin orð

Textinn hér að neðan er hans, óbreyttur.

01Asia

East of the MountainAustur fyrir fjall

The show Austur fyrir fjall (“East of the Mountain”) consisted of photos that I shot during my backpacking trip through Asia, from December of 2009 until May of 2010. I traveled through India, Nepal, Tibet, Vietnam and Cambodia, having eye-opening experiences at every turn and photographing the people I encountered. I like to refer to these images as “environmental portraits,” as they depict the subjects going about their day-to-day lives in their natural environment.

02Grapevine

Milos Forman

Prior to shooting Milos Forman, I had no idea who he was or what he did. This was probably for the best, as the knowledge that I was contending with a legendary, Oscar-winning filmmaker would probably have made me nervous. Forman arrived on location donning a pair of Crocs, and I tried very hard to get him to remove the ghastly plastic shoes. He resisted with all his might, until I gave him a cigar that I had for some reason brought along.

03Grapevine

Baltasar Kormákur

A true PHOTO EXPRESS job. At the last minute, I flew to North Iceland and drove from there to Hofsós, where I shot director Baltasar Kormákur in record time. As he and his wife made me coffee, I processed and sent the photos off to Grapevine HQ. I flew back to Reykjavík that night, and was greeted with a still warm, fresh off the presses copy of Grapevine bearing my image on the cover.

04Grapevine

Jón Gnarr

The mayor of Reykjavík, Jón Gnarr, shot in front of the City Hall. His last photoshoot before he left office. Been there done that. Inspired by Peter Sellers in Being There.

05Grapevine

Gunnar Nelson

Rising UFC star Gunnar Nelson is without any doubt the coolest Icelander I have ever captured through my lens. And when I say cool, I don’t mean in a big, tough-guy kind of sense, more in the Zen one; Gunnar is cool, calm, and collected.

Um Baldur

Baldur Kristjánsson

Baldur hefur verið ljósmyndari frá því hann var tólf ára en fór ekki að lifa af því fyrr en 2005. Hann sérhæfir sig í umhverfisportrettum: hann ver löngum tíma með fólki þar sem því líður vel og heima hjá sér, og lætur manneskjuna og umhverfið skýra hvort annað.

Ferill
Ljósmyndari frá tólf ára aldri, í fullu starfi frá 2005.
Ritstjórnarefni
Verk hans hafa birst í The New York Times og Der Spiegel.
Auglýsingar
Nike, Landsbankinn, Síminn, Coca Cola og Spotify.
Nám
Ekkert formlegt. Aðstoðarmaður Ara Magg í átján mánuði og ljósmyndari á stofunni hans í aðra átján.
Grapevine
Ljósmyndari Reykjavík Grapevine frá janúar 2007.

Kennsla Baldur kennir ljósmyndun í fjórtán fyrirlestrum á frami.is. Námskeiðið á frami.is
